Start date: 1355-05-18  
Add 9 months → 1356-02-18 (since May + 9 months = February of next year).  
Add 25 days → 1356-02-18 + 25 days = 1356-03-14 (February 1356 is a leap year? No, 1356 is divisible by 4, yes, leap year → Feb has 29 days).  
Check: Feb 18 + (29 − 18) = Feb 29 → 11 days used, remaining 14 days into March → March 14.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1356-03-14
